text:
elaine: FYI - P90 customer (acme-corp) escalated: canary rollout UI shows 'In progress' indefinitely for rollout r-9a2f. Console charts not updating, customer says it's been >30m. Ticket #12345. Anyone on this?

deploy-bot: Deployed eng-runtime v4.12.0 to prod at 2026-03-15T21:10Z (deploy id d-7783).

samir: @elaine seeing alerts for status-sync consumer lag since that deploy. I'll pull logs and check offsets.

anoop: Can you paste the rollout id + org id and any errors you saw? Also, is this just the console chart or are backend APIs returning stale state too?

elaine: rollout id r-9a2f, org acme-corp. Repro steps from support side: create a staged rollout -> start canary -> console shows spinner and the 'progress' metric stays at 0%. API returns a stable in_progress=true and last_heartbeat not advancing. Curl below: 

```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/rollouts/r-9a2f/status
{"rollout_id":"r-9a2f","in_progress":true,"last_heartbeat":"2026-03-15T21:05:12Z"}
```

samir: grabbing logs now. quick snippet: 

```
status_sync.consumer ERROR: failed to ack kafka message: TimeoutError during commit, retrying
status_sync.writer ERROR: Error writing state to state-store: Resource temporarily unavailable
```

This looks like the status-sync pipeline is falling behind and not committing heartbeat updates.

tess: Could this correlate with the recent batching change in the status writer (PR #3456)? That reduced write frequency but also changed the flush semantics.

anoop: @samir can you try a live restart of the status-sync deployment on prod-12 to clear the backlog? If that restores heartbeats it's a good mitigation. Also check redis/kv connections and file-descriptor saturation.

samir: did `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/status-sync` on prod-12 just now. Backlog drained, offsets caught up. I see heartbeats resuming in logs at 21:43:05Z and UI for ACME updated within ~45s.

elaine: Customer confirmed UI now shows progress and canary is advancing. Marking customer ticket as resolved for now. Workaround is restart status-sync if a single node is affected; escalate to infra if multiple. :white_check_mark:

kai: Filed escalation INF-2026-87 with initial timeline, logs, and deploy IDs. Assigned to eng-runtime + infra for RCA. :memo:

anoop: I'll open a rollback PR for the batching tweak and add more aggressive ack/latency metrics on the status writer. We should also add an alert on commit latency > 5s.

samir: adding logs and offsets to INF-2026-87. Will attach relevant commit ids (d-7783 / PR #3456) and the restart timestamp. Following up with a postmortem ETA in 4-6 hours.

elaine: Notes for support: - Symptoms: console rollout progress stuck "In progress"; API shows unchanged last_heartbeat - Immediate mitigation: restart status-sync deployment; confirm KV connections - Suspected cause: batching/flush semantics change caused write stalls under high write amplification - Next steps: rollback PR on batching change, add commit-latency metrics, and fail-open behavior to surface stale state in UI (so customers see a warning instead of spinner).

samir: thumbs up. I'll keep monitoring for recurrence and post logs to the incident.
